what_was_seen: THE BRIEF'S QUESTION: yes, screens still show a generated feed as Live or Healthy. HOLDS: the sign-in pages read "Across Chennai's 15 zones" and "8 DATA FEEDS", with no Live or நேரலை. The Collector's chip reads "6 of 8 feeds current · 2/8 live" (Tamil "2/8 நேரலை") and its tooltip reads "4 of 8 feeds are generated test data (grievance, police, pwd, hospital)." No Live or Healthy in the Collector's page bodies, the Officer's page bodies or the citizen's pages. Data Studio has no connector, so its Live and Healthy words apply to nothing generated; only "Live Connectors" and "Get the story, the map and a live dashboard." show. DOES NOT HOLD, the same words on other screens: (1) The Collector's Data sources list, the only feed table the console has, shows Police incident reports, PWD Water Resources, Hospital MIS and Grievance portal as "Healthy", with no Test data label, under "8 of 12 sources healthy. Added sources refresh on their own interval (daily by default); the pipeline feeds are collected every hour." The fix put its Test data label in FeedsBody (Overlays.tsx:174), which nothing imports. (2) The Officer's chip reads "6 of 8 feeds current · 6/8 live" for all three test departments, and its list "Data feeds · 6/8 live" (Tamil "6/8 நேரலை"), with a green tick beside police, PWD and hospital, on the same build where the Collector reads 2/8. Its tooltip still reads "Every source is collected hourly by the district intelligence pipeline." The fix filters on kind, but the query at officer/data.ts:247 does not fetch kind. FOUND ON THE WAY: Rain's Traffic tags "Police traffic reports, road accidents and road-damage complaints in rains" (689) as REAL, and all 244 of the reports the API links to an incident are is_synthetic_any=1. Rain's Power and Metro show generated figures with no label, though the API says kind generated (a code comment says this is on purpose). Ask District IQ's hint line says "Answers come from the console's live data" with no fake; its header says "Live data" with the model faked up (Tamil "நேரடித் தரவு"). Jarvis opened up to its consent note only, which was not accepted; no Live or Healthy on it. Jarvis's answer screen with a fake model says "Feeds healthy: 6. Feeds: 8." ALSO FOUND ON THE WAY: with no search index, "Any reports about a sinkhole?" gets "No incidents or news reports match that in the last 90 days" while "Any sinkhole?" gets "5 matching incidents in the last 90 days", and the store holds 51 news documents on it (audit-ui_honesty-14). CORRECTED FROM THE EARLIER REPORT OF THIS JOB: "How many feeds are live?" does not have one reply. With no index on disk it gets "No incidents or news reports match that in the last 90 days."; with an index on disk and this worktree's bad model file it got "Something went wrong while answering. Please try again.", which a test reading only the HTTP status took for an answer. Finding 11's first wording described one of these states only. NOT JUDGED: with no model key the new English strings ("Across Chennai's 15 zones", "DATA FEEDS", "Healthy", "8 of 12 sources healthy...") stay English in Tamil mode, because they are not in ta.ts or data/i18n/ta.json and only a model adds them. The PDF reports were checked by code search only (no feed wording in reportPdf.ts), not generated. A note on the fix: its filter also counts the grievance feed as "generated test data", while its kind says "synthetic history + live filings".
